fields.FIR_Description: On 2026-04-13 around 13:20 hrs, it was reported that a person offering to buy an item listed online asked the complainant to approve a UPI request, following which Rs. 45,000 was withdrawn. The online submission was made by Keerthana Sri (9000000319). Praveen Balan (9000000446) was mentioned as a person who was present nearby. The account reference SYN-ACC-100040 was noted in connection with the payment. The complaint mentions Karthik Shankar, who was reportedly contacted on 9000000306, in connection with the events. Potentially relevant material referenced includes a call detail reference and digital documents.
fields.Modus_Operandi: Fraudulent QR code allegedly shared under the pretext of a refund.
fields.Keywords: UPI fraud, online payment, witness, mobile number, residential colony, suspect, digital document, receiving account
